Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 5

“For no one can remain even a moment without performing action. Everyone is made to act, helplessly, by the qualities born of nature.”

A blunt fact of biology and psychology. Even sitting still is doing something. Since action turns out to be unavoidable, the question shifts from whether to act to how.
